result.instructions: Tools for Kayako, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kayako data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run kayako_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kayako_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kayako_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. kayako_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kayako_get_me
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Kayako user these credentials belong to (name, role, teams, locale). A cheap way to confirm the subdomain and credentials work. Kayako: GET /api/v1/me.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: List cases (conversations / tickets), newest-updated first. Filter by status type, tags, max priority level, or a requester identity (email, Twitter screen name, Facebook username, phone); or fetch specific ids. Nested resources are references unless `include` expands them. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases.json.

priority.description: Include cases whose priority level is less than or equal to this level.

identity_type.description: Filter by the requester's identity type; requires identity_value.

identity_value.description: Email, Facebook username, Twitter screen name or phone number, matching identity_type.

ids.description: Fetch these case ids instead of filtering.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

fields.description: Partial-output field rules, e.g. '+tags' to add tags to a case, or 'subject,status' to return only those.

tools.name: kayako_get_case
tools.title: Get a case
tools.description: Fetch one case (conversation) by id: subject, requester, assignee, status, priority, type, SLA metrics, custom fields, last post preview. Use include (e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team') to expand references and fields='+tags' for tags. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}.json.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

fields.description: Partial-output field rules, e.g. '+tags' to add tags to a case, or 'subject,status' to return only those.

tools.name: kayako_list_case_posts
tools.title: List a case's posts
tools.description: Read a case's timeline: customer messages, agent replies and internal notes (newest first). By default activities are excluded; filters='NOTES' for internal notes only, 'MESSAGES' for messages, 'ALL' to include activities. Paginate with before_id / after_id (one at a time). Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}/posts.json.

filters.description: Which kinds of post to return.

after_id.description: Cursor: return the page after this post id.

before_id.description: Cursor: return the page before this post id.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_list_channels
tools.title: List reply channels
tools.description: List the channels (MAIL mailbox, TWITTER, FACEBOOK, NOTE) usable for a reply on an existing case (pass case_id) or for a new case (omit case_id; optionally pass the requester's user_id). A channel's account.id is the channel_id to pass to kayako_reply_to_case / kayako_create_case. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}/reply/channels.json or GET /api/v1/cases/channels.json.

user_id.description: Requester of a NEW case (ignored with case_id).

tools.name: kayako_list_case_options
tools.title: List case statuses, priorities or types
tools.description: List the instance's case statuses (id, label, type), priorities (id, label, level) or types (id, label, type) — the ids needed for status_id / priority_id / type_id when creating, updating or replying to a case. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{statuses|priorities|types}.json.

annotations.title: List case statuses, priorities or types

tools.name: kayako_search
tools.title: Search cases, users and organizations
tools.description: Unified search across conversations (cases), users and organizations. Returns id, title, snippet, relevance and resource type; pass fields='*' to get each full resource inline. Max 30 results. Kayako: GET /api/v1/search.json.

fields.description: Resource fields to return, e.g. '*' for full resources.

tools.name: kayako_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (customers, collaborators, agents, admins), newest first, optionally by role type or specific ids. To find a user by email or name use kayako_search. Kayako: GET /api/v1/users.json.

role.description: Only users of this role type.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id: name, role, organization, teams, identities (emails, phones, social), custom fields. include='identity_email,organization' expands references. Kayako: GET /api/v1/users/{id}.json.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations (name, domains, phone, custom fields), oldest first. To find one by name use kayako_search with resources=['ORGANIZATIONS']. Kayako: GET /api/v1/organizations.json.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_list_organization_cases
tools.title: List an organization's cases
tools.description: List the cases (conversations) raised by members of one organization, newest-updated first. Kayako: GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/cases.json.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List agent teams (id, title, member count) — the ids for assigned_team_id. Kayako: GET /api/v1/teams.json.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

tools.name: kayako_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List user roles (id, title, type OWNER/ADMIN/AGENT/COLLABORATOR/CUSTOMER) — the role_id needed by kayako_create_user. Kayako: GET /api/v1/roles.json.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

tools.name: kayako_list_articles
tools.title: List help-center articles
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles, optionally by section, tags, or PUBLISHED / PINNED. Titles and contents are locale references unless include='locale_field'. Kayako: GET /api/v1/articles.json.

filter.description: Only pinned or only published articles.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

include.description: Comma-separated resource types to expand instead of returning {id, resource_type} references, e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team', or '*' for all.

tools.name: kayako_get_article
tools.title: Get a help-center article
tools.description: Fetch one knowledge-base article with its localized titles and contents expanded (include defaults to 'locale_field'), status, section, tags, votes and help-center URL. Kayako: GET /api/v1/articles/{id}.json.

include.description: Resource types to expand. Defaults to 'locale_field' so titles/contents are readable.

tools.name: kayako_search_help_center
tools.title: Search the help center
tools.description: Search the help center's articles and/or public conversations. Returns references (e.g. {id, resource_type: 'article'}); read an article with kayako_get_article. Kayako: GET /api/v1/helpcenter/search.json.

limit.description: Items per page, 1-100. Kayako's default is 10.

tools.name: kayako_create_case
tools.title: Create a case
tools.description: WRITE: open a new case (conversation) for a requester. channel MAIL sends the first message to the customer by email from the mailbox given as channel_id; channel NOTE creates it with an internal note and emails nobody. Get channel ids from kayako_list_channels and status/priority/type ids from kayako_list_case_options. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases.json.

channel.description: MAIL, TWITTER, FACEBOOK or NOTE (internal, not sent).

channel_id.description: Channel account id (e.g. the mailbox id). Required unless channel is NOTE.

html.description: MAIL/NOTE: treat contents as HTML (sanitized by Kayako).

field_values.description: Custom field values keyed by field key, e.g. {"order_number": "1234"}. For multi-select fields pass CSV options — ALL options must be passed; omitted ones are removed.

tools.name: kayako_update_case
tools.title: Update a case
tools.description: WRITE: change a case's subject, requester, assignee (team/agent), status, priority, type, brand, form, tags or custom fields. Sends nothing to the customer. `tags` sets the case's tag list (use kayako_add_case_tags to append). Trashing is deliberately not exposed. Kayako: PUT /api/v1/cases/{id}.json.

field_values.description: Custom field values keyed by field key, e.g. {"order_number": "1234"}. For multi-select fields pass CSV options — ALL options must be passed; omitted ones are removed.

tools.name: kayako_reply_to_case
tools.title: Reply to a case or add an internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add a post to a case. channel NOTE adds an INTERNAL note visible only to agents (no channel_id needed). channel MAIL/TWITTER/FACEBOOK sends a PUBLIC reply to the customer — get channel_id from kayako_list_channels with case_id. Can also set status/priority/assignee in the same call. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/reply.json.

channel.description: NOTE for an internal note; MAIL/TWITTER/FACEBOOK for a public reply.

channel_id.description: Channel account id. Required unless channel is NOTE.

html.description: NOTE only: treat contents as HTML (sanitized by Kayako).

annotations.title: Reply to a case or add an internal note

tools.name: kayako_add_case_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a case
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to a case, keeping its existing tags. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/tags.json.

tools.name: kayako_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: WRITE: create a user — typically a CUSTOMER to use as requester_id on a new case. role_id comes from kayako_list_roles. Collaborator/agent/admin roles also require email and team_ids. No password is set by this tool. Kayako: POST /api/v1/users.json.

email.description: Primary email. Required for collaborator/agent/admin roles.

organization_case_access.description: CUSTOMER only: see only own cases (default) or the whole organization's.

field_values.description: Custom field values keyed by field key, e.g. {"order_number": "1234"}. For multi-select fields pass CSV options — ALL options must be passed; omitted ones are removed.
